abstract: One hundred patients with advanced mixed germ-cell tumors were treated with cisplatin, cyclophosphamide, and doxorubicin alternating with vinblastine and bleomycin (cyclic CISCAII/VBIV). The chemotherapy achieved an 89 percent continuous disease-free status (85 percent with chemotherapy, 4 percent with chemotherapy plus surgery). The mean follow-up duration for patients with continuous complete remission was 132 weeks (+/- 6.2), with a median of 126 weeks. Multivariate analysis using a stepwise logistic regression of prognostic variables revealed that a high serum level of the beta subunit of human chorionic gonadotropin (more than 50,000 mIU/ml) was of prognostic significance, followed by the Samuels staging criteria and extragonadal origin of disease. Thirty-two patients underwent exploratory surgery after they had had two courses of chemotherapy beyond the establishment of a stable mass and absent serum biomarkers. No viable cancer was found at exploration, and all patients remain alive and free of disease. The acute toxicity of the cyclic chemotherapy was formidable, but only one patient had a fatal complication. Thirty-six percent of the CISCAII courses and 44 percent of the VBIV courses were associated with leukopenic fever, and 5 percent of the CISCAII courses and 8 percent of the VBIV courses were associated with culture-positive infection. Long-term toxicity was unusual: bleomycin lung toxicity 1 percent, cardiac toxicity 1 percent. CISCAII/VBIV cyclic chemotherapy is superior to cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin (PVB) chemotherapy; it results in a higher complete remission rate, a lower relapse rate, and a lower incidence of long-term complications. Patients with a high risk of failure of PVB chemotherapy (Samuels stage IIIB3 to IIIB5) or with extragonadal tumors should be treated with CISCAII/VBIV.
abstract_ja: 進行性混合型胚細胞腫瘍の患者100例を、シスプラチン・シクロホスファミド・ドキソルビシンをビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシンと交互に投与する周期的化学療法(CISCAII/VBIV)で治療した。化学療法により89%が持続的な無病状態となった(化学療法単独で85%、化学療法と手術の併用で4%)。持続的完全寛解例の平均フォローアップ期間は132週(±6.2)、中央値は126週であった。ステップワイズロジスティック回帰による多変量解析では、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)βサブユニットの高値(50,000 mIU/mL超)が予後因子として重要であり、続いてSamuels病期分類、性腺外発生が有意であった。32例は、安定した腫瘤が確立し血清腫瘍マーカーが陰性となった後、2コースの化学療法を経て探索的手術を受けた。探索時に生存腫瘍は認められず、全例が生存し無病である。周期的化学療法の急性毒性は著しかったが、致死的な合併症は1例のみであった。長期毒性はまれで、ブレオマイシン肺毒性1%、心毒性1%であった。CISCAII/VBIVの周期的化学療法は、PVB療法より優れている。完全寛解率が高く、再発率が低く、長期合併症の発生率も低い。PVB療法の失敗リスクが高い患者(Samuels病期分類IIIB3〜IIIB5)や性腺外腫瘍の患者には、CISCAII/VBIVを用いるべきである。
